title: Marvel Hero Training Day
intro: [excited] Welcome, recruits, to Disney Jeopardy! Tonight is Marvel hero training day, and I am your very smooth drill instructor. Stretch those muscles, polish those capes, and remember... every hero starts somewhere.

art.prompt: A cheerful hero training obstacle course on a sunny rooftop, colorful targets, padded walls and a small jet parked nearby, original painterly animated-film style artwork, wide 16:9 composition, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

categories.title: Suit Up
categories.intro: We start with the basics: big heroes, big gear, big screen. [chuckles] Suit up, everybody.

art.prompt: A row of glowing high-tech armor suits standing in a sleek workshop lit in red and gold, original painterly animated-film style artwork, wide 16:9 composition, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: Tony Stark builds high-tech armor and fights crime as this hero.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Iron Man! Genius, billionaire, and the snappiest dresser in the Avengers.

clues.clue: This huge green Avenger gets bigger and stronger when he gets angry.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Hulk! [laughs] Hulk smash... the competition.

clues.clue: Captain America's famous round shield is made mostly of this rare metal.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is vibranium! Light, tough, and it bounces back like your host after a bad joke.

clues.clue: In the movie Black Panther, T'Challa is king of this hidden African nation.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Wakanda! [excited] Wakanda forever!

clues.clue: Star-Lord loves his Awesome Mix tapes, which he plays on this kind of portable cassette player.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is a Walkman! Retro, portable, and full of seventies hits. Chet approves.

categories.title: Hero Pets
categories.intro: Even heroes need a furry friend. [chuckles] Name these Marvel pets and creatures. No petting the alien cat, please.

art.prompt: A cozy hero clubhouse living room with a dog bed, a cat tree and a tiny spacesuit hanging on a hook, original painterly animated-film style artwork, wide 16:9 composition, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: Carol Danvers' cat Goose looks like an ordinary orange tabby but is really this tentacled alien creature.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is a Flerken! Tentacles in the tummy. [laughs] Do not scratch behind those ears.

clues.clue: Cosmo, the talking space dog in Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3, was once a test dog in this country's space program.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Soviet Union! Cosmo is a very good girl. [excited] Good girl!

clues.clue: Lockjaw, a giant teleporting bulldog with an antenna on his forehead, is the beloved pet of this royal family of heroes.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is the Inhumans! One sniff and poof, Lockjaw teleports you across town.

clues.clue: In Thor: Ragnarok, Hela rides into battle with this giant wolf at her side.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Fenris! [dramatically] Big wolf, bad attitude.

clues.clue: In the Disney+ series Hawkeye, Kate Bishop adopts this one-eyed golden retriever who loves pizza.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Lucky the Pizza Dog! One eye, all heart, extra cheese.

categories.title: Whose Gear?
categories.intro: Picture category! Look at the gear on screen and tell me which hero or villain it belongs to.

art.prompt: A hero equipment locker room with open lockers holding mysterious glowing gadgets, original painterly animated-film style artwork, wide 16:9 composition, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: Which god of thunder swings this? Pictured: a heavy short-handled stone-gray war hammer with a leather-wrapped grip.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Thor! Only the worthy may lift it. Chet tried. [laughs] Chet was not worthy.

media.prompt: A heavy short-handled stone-gray war hammer with a leather-wrapped grip, crackling with blue lightning on a cloudy hilltop, original painterly illustration, no text, no logos, no people, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: Which sharpshooting Avenger uses this?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Hawkeye! Never miss... unless it is on purpose.

clues.clue: Which flying hero straps on this?
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is the Falcon! Sam Wilson takes to the sky with a backpack and a smile.

clues.clue: Which purple villain wore this to snap his fingers?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Thanos! [dramatically] One snap and half the audience vanished. Rude.

clues.clue: This floating red garment, which has a mind of its own, is known as the Cloak of this.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is the Cloak of Levitation! It chose Doctor Strange. Chet's coat just chooses the floor.

categories.title: Recruit Report
categories.intro: To the parks! Time for a field trip to the Marvel lands. [excited] Recruits, report for duty.

art.prompt: A bright modern hero training campus plaza with sleek buildings and a jet perched on a rooftop, original painterly animated-film style artwork, wide 16:9 composition, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: At Avengers Campus, this family ride lets you sling webs with your own hand motions to catch runaway Spider-Bots.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is WEB SLINGERS! Wave those arms, sling those webs, save the day.

clues.clue: Avengers Campus opened in 2021 inside this California theme park.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Disney California Adventure! [excited] Right across from Disneyland.

clues.clue: Guardians of the Galaxy - Mission: BREAKOUT! took over the building of this spooky drop ride.
clues.answer: The Twilight Zone Tower of Terror
accept: the twilight zone tower of terror
choices: The Twilight Zone Tower of Terror
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is the Tower of Terror! Out with the haunted hotel, in with the dancing raccoon.

clues.clue: Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind, a spinning coaster set to classic hits, is found at this Walt Disney World park.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is EPCOT! [excited] One of the longest enclosed coasters in the world.

clues.clue: At Disneyland Paris, the coaster Avengers Assemble: Flight Force teams riders with Iron Man and this cosmic hero.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Captain Marvel! Higher, further, faster, and with a French accent.

categories.title: Animated Avengers
categories.intro: Marvel heroes go animated! These cartoons and films are perfect for the whole family. [chuckles] Pass the popcorn.

art.prompt: A cozy living room at night with a glowing television, a bowl of popcorn and toy robots on the shelf, original painterly animated-film style artwork, wide 16:9 composition, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: This 2014 Disney animated film about Hiro and his huggable robot Baymax was inspired by a Marvel comic team.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Big Hero 6! It even won the Oscar for Best Animated Feature.

clues.clue: On Disney Junior's Spidey and His Amazing Friends, Miles Morales goes by this hero name.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Spin! [excited] Peter, Gwen and Miles, the cutest web-slinging team on TV.

clues.clue: On Moon Girl and Devil Dinosaur, Lunella Lafayette protects this Manhattan neighborhood.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is the Lower East Side! A genius kid, a giant red dinosaur, and one very lucky neighborhood.

clues.clue: Baymax asks every patient to rate this on a scale of one to ten.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is pain! [chuckles] Chet rates this category a solid ten.

clues.clue: Big Hero 6 takes place in this city, a mashup of two famous Pacific cities.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is San Fransokyo! Cable cars, cherry blossoms, and robots. Dreamy.
